net_receipts_definition: Gross platform-owned receipts less processor fees, refunds, chargebacks, taxes required to be collected/remitted, and legally restricted pass-through amounts. Charitable/pass-through funds are never reclassified as platform revenue.
invariants: No platform owner revenue share may be retained from platform net receipts.
100% of platform net receipts are economically assigned to the Eva & Anastasia Beneficiary Pool.
No payout may be marked completed without a payment-processor settlement/transfer identifier.
No application UI may display fabricated earnings or payout values as real data.
If payout destination is not valid/verified, settlement remains pending; funds must not be redirected to an alternate beneficiary.
